faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at IIT (BHU) Varanasi?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Research Associate position at IIT (BHU) Varanasi is 28th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MA in History with at least 55% marks and have proficiency in the Bengali language, both in reading and writing.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 17,600 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT (BHU) Varanasi located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of IIT (BHU) Varanasi, which is www.iitbhu.ac.in.
